Package org.bsc.langgraph4j.agentexecutor

Class MessageWindowConversationContextPolicy

java.lang.Object
org.bsc.langgraph4j.agentexecutor.MessageWindowConversationContextPolicy
All Implemented Interfaces:
ConversationContextPolicy<dev.langchain4j.data.message.ChatMessage>
public class MessageWindowConversationContextPolicy extends Object implements ConversationContextPolicy<dev.langchain4j.data.message.ChatMessage>
Sliding-window conversation context policy that keeps at most maxMessages graph messages. Patterned after the MessageWindowChatMemory from langchain4j

A leading SystemMessage is preserved while evicting old messages. If an evicted AiMessage contains tool execution requests, following orphan ToolExecutionResultMessages are evicted as well.
